scope: Post hoc descriptive reanalysis of existing B outcomes; no simulation or training
posthoc_selection_unit: One whole policy per parent x continuation, never separate actions per evaluation case
observed_fixed_reference: max of aggregate mean J8 and aggregate mean J40; descriptive only
leave_one_parent_out: Remove both paths and recompute both fixed means and the observed better fixed action
uncertainty: No new oracle confidence interval; retain version49 intervals for fixed comparisons
future_replication: optional proposal only, not authorized or scheduled
